title: pilosella densiflora subsp. manothyrsa
intro: Pilosella densiflora subsp. manothyrsa, commonly known as a type of plant in the Asteraceae family, is a plant species that belongs to the Pilosella genus, which is a group of plants that are known for their medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions such as arthritis and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella densiflora subsp. manothyrsa include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
